_comment: Copy this file to hardware.json and edit it to match your kit.
hardware.json is gitignored: Connection Card colors and serials are
specific to the physical hardware in front of you.
Each device has its own card. Read the color and the serial number off
the Connection Card that came with it.
card_color:  green | blue | red | orange | yellow | azure | purple | magenta
card_serial: the digits printed on the card, as a string
